source.title: Guidelines for Competency Based Postgraduate Training Programme for MD in Radiodiagnosis

requirements.label: Log book checked and signed regularly by the faculty-in-charge
requirements.quote: A log book should be maintained by the student and will be checked and signed regularly by the faculty-in-charge during the training program.

requirements.label: Teaching and training of undergraduates and interns
requirements.quote: The postgraduate students shall be required to participate in the teaching and training program of undergraduate students and interns.
requirements.note: MD Radiodiagnosis writes 'program'; the other 2019-era guidelines write 'programme'. Quoted as printed.

requirements.label: One poster presentation
requirements.quote: The postgraduate student would be required to present one poster presentation, to read one paper at a national/state conference and to submit one research paper which should be published or accepted for publication or sent for publication to a peer reviewed journal, during the period of his/her postgraduate studies so as to make him/her eligible to appear at the postgraduate degree examination.

requirements.label: One paper read at a national/state conference
requirements.quote: …to read one paper at a national/state conference…

requirements.label: One research paper submitted to a peer-reviewed journal
requirements.quote: …to submit one research paper which should be published or accepted for publication or sent for publication to a peer reviewed journal…

proceduresNote: No procedure/study counts in the MD Radiodiagnosis guidelines.
disclaimer: Requirements are traced to the NMC source named above. A requirement with target null is one the source mandates WITHOUT giving a number — it is counted, never scored against an invented target. This pack does not certify compliance; see NMC_PG_LOGBOOK_REQUIREMENTS.md.
